description:
Retrofit the sample house with accessibility features by installing a wheelchair ramp at the front entrance.

Your goal is to:
1. Open the 'Sample House' project in DreamPlan Home Design Software (if not already loaded).
2. Navigate to the front entrance where the porch is located.
3. Install a wheelchair ramp connecting the ground level to the porch level using the dedicated Ramp tool (found under Building > Stairs > Ramp).
4. Ensure the ramp is properly sloped and includes safety railings.
5. Verify the installation in 3D view.
6. Save the project.
7. Take a screenshot of the 3D view showing the installed ramp and save it to 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\ramp_install.png'.
